subject: Peregrine Systems — Private Deployment: networking runbook + on-prem packaging timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@peregrine.io>, Elena Torres <elena.t@peregrine.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Peregrine Systems private deployment — initial checklist & proposed timeline

Hi Samir / Elena,

Nice to meet you both — I'm Marcus, the CS engineer who will run the networking and on-prem packaging side of the Peregrine private deployment. To get the implementation moving I want to align on a short preflight and propose a week-by-week timeline that covers VPC peering, private endpoints, and the on-prem appliance package handoff.

High-level asks for prework (can you confirm these items this week?):
- Network inventory (VPC IDs, account IDs, CIDR blocks, region preference)
- List of endpoints that must reach Redwood (DNS names / FQDNs, ports)
- Firewall & proxy constraints (eg outbound proxy details, deep packet inspection)
- Sizing constraints for on-prem package (cores, RAM, disk)

Proposed milestones:
1) Preflight & inventory (3 business days) — share network inventory & firewall matrix
2) Design review (1 day) — joint call to review peering topology and private endpoints
3) Packaging & certificate exchange (5 business days) — deliver on-prem bundle and CSR flow
4) Validation & acceptance (3 business days) — smoke tests, latency checks, connection validation

I've attached an initial checklist to make the preflight fast. Can we lock a 60-minute design review on either Tue 2027-05-31 or Wed 2027-06-01 (US-friendly times)? If you prefer a different cadence, share availability and we'll flex.

Attachments: [Attachment: initial-deploy-checklist.xlsx (Excel)]

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0134

--
On a related note, CC'ing Marissa to align on customer success milestones and Irene for the on-prem packaging handoff.
From: Elena Torres <elena.t@peregrine.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@peregrine.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Peregrine Systems private deployment — initial checklist & proposed timeline

Hi Marcus,

Thanks — this looks good. We're aiming for a private deployment across our primary account in us-east-1. I can confirm we will have the network inventory ready by end of day Friday (2027-05-28). A couple quick clarifications:

- Peering: we prefer cross-account VPC peering initially; we may explore Transit Gateway later.
- Private endpoints: we'd like the Redwood private endpoint to live in a dedicated subnet.
- On-prem appliance: our infra team needs expected hardware constraints in order to confirm procurement timelines. Do you have a sizing baseline we can reference?

Samir is our IT ops lead and will provide the network inventory PDF.

Availability for the design review call: Tue 2027-05-31 16:00 - 17:00 UTC works for us.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Platform Ops — Peregrine Systems
elena.t@peregrine.io

[Attachment: internal-stakeholders.csv (CSV)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena.t@peregrine.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Peregrine Systems private deployment — initial checklist & proposed timeline

Thanks for the context. Quick operational notes from CS side:

- I'll run the onboarding milestones and set the acceptance criteria for the validation phase.
- Suggest we treat the packaging handoff as a gated sprint: Redwood prepares the bundle, Peregrine validates in staging, then we schedule a controlled production cutover.
- I'll open ENG-2147 so engineering can track the implementation tasks; Marcus, please add any runbook items to that ticket.

Marcus — for sizing baseline, Irene (copied) has a reference appliance manifest we use for first-pass sizing. Irene, can you drop the manifest in the shared drive and call out any optional components that add >20% CPU or memory overhead?

Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1A2bPeregrine-implementation-runbook

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@peregrine.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena.t@peregrine.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 15:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Peregrine Systems private deployment — initial checklist & proposed timeline

Marcus / Elena / Marissa,

Attached is our network inventory and a short note from our security team. Key items:
- Primary account: 123456789012 (us-east-1)
- VPC: vpc-0a1b2c3d (CIDR 10.10.0.0/16)
- Preferred peering region: us-east-1
- Required outbound ports to Redwood: 443 (TLS), 5222 (if mutual TLS push is used)
- We have an outbound web proxy at 10.0.0.5:3128 (transparent proxy with ACLs)

Firewall & proxy considerations: our security team requires a small allowlist of Redwood egress IP ranges (can you provide the maintenance window IP list?). Also, we will place the Redwood private endpoint in subnet subnet-0b2c3d4e as requested.

Attachment: [Attachment: peregrine-network-inventory.pdf (PDF)]

On the appliance sizing question: our procurement lead needs expected disk and CPU nominal values. Elena, please loop procurement and I'll get them the doc.

Thanks,
Samir Gupta
IT Operations — Peregrine Systems
samir.gupta@peregrine.io

Great, thanks Samir — got the inventory and the proxy note. Next steps and ownership: 

- Marcus (me): produce runbook draft + maintenance-window IP list by Tue 2027-06-01 EOD (ENG-2147).
- Irene: produce on-prem appliance manifest (baseline + optional components) and upload to the runbook folder by Mon 2027-05-31.
- Marissa: schedule acceptance window & validation checklist, coordinate procurement as needed.
- Peregrine (Elena / Samir): confirm procurement lead contact and confirm design review attendance for Tue 2027-05-31 16:00 UTC.

For the IP allowlist: we'll provide a short-term list for the initial peering and a longer-term CIDR set for maintenance. Expect the document by Tue 2027-06-01.

Attachments: [Attachment: onprem-appliance-sizing.csv (CSV), Attachment: runbook-draft-v0.1.md (Markdown)]

See you on the call — I'll send a calendar invite shortly (ENG-2147).
